description: Portable build of Helium, a privacy-focused Chromium fork, bundled with the Chrome++ portability layer
notes: Profile and cache live in '$dir\Data' and '$dir\Cache' and are persisted across updates.

Chrome++ settings live in '$dir\Helium\chrome++.ini'. That file is rebuilt from upstream on every release and is deliberately not persisted, so keep a copy of any edits — it is what lets newly added Chrome++ options reach you automatically.

Helium's built-in WinSparkle updater is deliberately pointed at an invalid domain. Left enabled it installs a second, non-portable copy under '%LOCALAPPDATA%\imput\Helium' and takes over the browser registrations. Update with 'scoop update helium-portable' instead; Chromium component updates are unaffected.
Close all Helium windows before updating or uninstalling, otherwise the old version directory stays locked and 'scoop cleanup' fails.
This is a Chrome++ repack built from a personal fork of Piracola/Helium_Portable, not an official imputnet release.
pre_install: # Scoop already registers the Start Menu shortcut, and the Helium.lnk this script
# writes would point into a versioned directory that the next update supersedes.
